description: Converts up to 20 public web pages to clean markdown in one call. Returns each page's title and markdown body (headings, links, list items, paragraphs; scripts and styles removed), capped at 20,000 characters per page, with a 25-second time limit. Every URL is fetched through a public-internet-only safe fetcher. Use it to pull several docs or articles into one batch instead of making 20 separate calls. Paid only: $0.25 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/bulk-page-to-markdown.
name: bulk-page-to-markdown
